questions.stem: A power station has a boiler that is 85% efficient and a generator that is 90% efficient. What is the overall efficiency?
questions.explanation: For multiple stages, multiply the individual efficiencies: 0.85 x 0.90 = 0.765 = 76.5%. The overall efficiency is always less than the lowest individual efficiency.

questions.stem: Which of the following would NOT improve the efficiency of a machine?

options.text: Adding insulation to reduce heat loss

questions.explanation: Increasing the input energy does not change the ratio of useful output to total input, so it does not improve efficiency. Lubrication, insulation, and streamlining all reduce wasted energy, improving efficiency.
